icons.construction: Straight centerlines keep the symbol readable without an enclosing frame. Centerline bounds x=4..20 and y=6..18 give balanced opposite visible margins of 3.15 horizontally and 5.15 vertically. The arrow pair is mirrored about x=12. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 4 draft awaiting owner review.

icons.name: bell
icons.description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The integrated top hanger is shortened by 0.5 unit (from 2.3 to 1.8 units above its shoulder junction) so it reads as a compact nub. The full drawing is then translated upward by 0.25 unit to keep opposite vertical margins balanced: centerline bounds y=2.75..21.25, visible Regular bounds y=1.9..22.1. Straight walls, shoulders, lower lip and clapper proportions are retained. No doubled seams. Owner-approved source; Outline geometry retained through the Filled clapper correction.

review.note: Owner approved Bell after the solid Filled clapper correction. Both styles reviewed at source proportions and Regular 1.70; the Filled clapper is a solid part with no U-shaped recess.

icons.name: camera
icons.description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Rounded rectangular body uses the Folder corner rhythm. The left and right shoulders have explicit 3-unit horizontal ledges at y=6.8 (x=5..8 and x=16..19), with a narrower raised housing to keep both straight spans visible. The indicator is a zero-length segment centered at 17.9,9.5 with round caps, forming a solid circular dot whose diameter follows the stroke. This avoids the hollow-ring rendering of a tiny stroked circle under non-scaling preview strokes at high zoom. The circular lens is centered at 12,13.2. Source bounds x=3..21 and y=4.1..19.9 balance opposite margins. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Camera Outline and Filled at source proportions.

icons.name: check
icons.description: A clear check mark with a compact lead-in and a longer rising arm.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The short diagonal runs from 5.5,12.5 to 9.5,16.5; the longer arm rises to 18.5,7.5. Both arms use true 45-degree straight segments with one rounded joint and two rounded ends. Native bounds are centered about 12,12, giving Regular visible margins 4.65 horizontally and 6.65 vertically. The unequal arm lengths preserve a recognizable check silhouette. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.

icons.construction: Mirrored 45-degree arms meet at 12,15.25, with endpoints at 5.5,8.75 and 18.5,8.75. A single continuous centerline avoids doubled joins. Native bounds are centered at 12,12. Regular visible margins are 4.65 horizontally and 7.9 vertically. Rounded caps and the rounded lower vertex use the shared 1.70 stroke. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.

icons.name: copy
icons.description: Two overlapping rounded pages with a distinct foreground sheet.

The rear outline runs from 7.5,16.5 around the upper-left page to 16.5,7.5, with its endpoints terminating within the foreground boundary stroke. The foreground page centerline bounds are 7.5..21 on both axes. Combined centerline bounds are 3..21, giving balanced Regular visible margins of 2.15. icons.name: heart
icons.description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point.

icons.construction: The lower silhouette is a slim V with only a slight outward convex bow. Mirrored quadratic flanks depart subtly from straight diagonals and meet a compact rounded tip. Tangents align through the side transitions and tip without inward inflections. The established upper lobes and notch are retained. Outline bounds x=3.25..20.75, y=4.1..19.9 remain centered. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Heart Outline and Filled after the head alignment and centered-grid review. The reviewed Lab preview used X/Y=95%; these local preview settings are recorded without changing the source geometry.

icons.name: moon
icons.description: A balanced crescent moon with a clean circular concavity.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The crescent preserves the recognizable lunar silhouette as an intentional circular exception to the rounded rectangular object baseline. A radius-8 outer arc and a radius-10 concave inner arc share the original horn endpoints. At the owner request for a deeper inward curve, the concavity is deepened by approximately .75 unit at its midpoint compared with the previous radius-12 revision. The body stays fuller than the initial radius-8 and radius-9 studies. The outer contour, both horn endpoints and Regular 1.70 stroke weight are retained. One closed path avoids doubled edges. Native centerline bounds remain x/y=4.35424869..19.64575131; Regular 1.70 gives equal opposite visible margins of 3.50424869. Rounded stroke joins soften both horns. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Moon Outline and Filled after the fuller crescent and deeper inner-arc revisions. Final geometry uses a radius-8 outer arc and radius-10 inner concavity, at native proportions and Regular 1.70.

icons.name: plus
icons.description: A centered plus mark with four equally sized arms.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: At the owner request, each perpendicular centerline is extended by 1 unit total, from length 13 to length 14. Endpoints move equally from 5.5/18.5 to 5/19 about the shared center 12,12. All four free ends retain radius-.85 caps at Regular 1.70. Visible native dimensions are 15.70 by 15.70, with equal margins of 4.15 units. This drawing is the construction source for X. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review. The owner subsequently requested a Filled-only solid rounded box with a negative-space glyph and 2-unit clearance. Outline retains this unboxed drawing; its visible Regular exterior matches the Filled glyph cutout, not the added box.

review.note: Owner approved Settings Outline and Filled at the previous 30-degree preview orientation. At the owner's request, that orientation is now baked into both original SVGs and is the native 0-degree baseline. Exterior and hub alignment are preserved at Regular 1.70.

Native proportions are the reference; Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Sun Outline and Filled after enlarging the central disc and shortening the eight rays. Reviewed at native proportions and Regular 1.70.

icons.name: x
icons.description: A centered close mark with two balanced diagonal strokes.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Owner clarified that the Filled box must keep 2px outside clearance and Outline is exactly the X inside that Filled box, following Plus. The upright rounded box spans 2..22 on the native 24 by 24 grid, with radius-2.85 corners. Its negative-space X and the standalone Outline share diagonal centerline endpoints 4.85..19.15 on each axis, giving visible glyph bounds 4..20. The shared glyph retains Regular-equivalent width 1.70 and .85 round caps. This leaves exactly 2 units between the glyph and each box side, plus 2 units between the box and each artboard side. The cutout is the exact analytical union of the Outline stroke exterior. Both glyphs are centered at 12,12 with identical position, size and contours; no style-specific scaling or translation. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
